g.text: Three homologous pairs (2n = 6). I: sister chromatids, chiasmata, centrosomes with centriole pairs,
spindle, nuclear-envelope fragments, centromere/kinetochore, metaphase plate and kinetochore microtubules.
Sisters remain joined in I: homologs separate → two n = 3 cells. In II sisters separate → four n = 3
haploid cells. Reciprocal crossover segments remain visible.
